subject: CAIQ: Key rotation, 2FA and HSM evidence request
messages:
From: Lucas Moreno <lucas.moreno@bigbank.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: controls related to auth/key rotation

Hi Priya / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As part of our CAIQ assessment for Redwood (BigBank intake), we flagged a small set of controls we need evidence for: CSA CCM controls around identity lifecycle (IAC-01/IAC-03 equivalents), key management (EN-02/EN-03), and multi-factor authentication for admin consoles.

Can you please provide:
- Your key rotation policy and the most recent rotation log for master KMS keys (CSV or log snapshot)
- Evidence that all admin console access enforces 2FA (screenshots + date-stamped audit entries)
- Any HSM attestation or vendor report if keys are backed by HSMs

I've attached the CAI matrix we maintain and annotated lines where we need artifacts (BigBank_CAIMatrix.xlsx). We're on a tight schedule for the internal risk committee; would appreciate initial evidence by EOD Thursday, Jan 21. If some items require additional approvals, let us know an expected ETA.

Thanks—
Lucas
Lucas Moreno

Hi Lucas —

Thanks for the clear list and the annotated matrix. We've triaged the ask and split owners:
- Key rotation policy + rotation log: Rishi (cc'd) will pull policy and a 12-month key rotation audit snapshot.
- 2FA proof for admin console: Laura will collect screenshots and audit entries from the auth provider for our org-admin roles.
- HSM attestation: we'll confirm whether the customer master keys are HSM-backed and get any vendor attestation if available.

Plan / ETA: Rishi and Laura will aim to put the primary artifacts in a shared folder by EOD Wed, Jan 20, with follow-ups for anything that requires legal or vendor engagement by Thu, Jan 21. If we need to extend, we'll flag the specific control rows in your matrix.

I'll monitor and escalate if we hit procurement/legal gates.

Action items:
- Rishi: gather key-rotation-policy.pdf and recent KMS audit snapshot
- Laura: gather 2FA screenshots and admin audit entries
- Priya: confirm HSM status and provide a note if vendor attestation is required

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

Thanks Rishi — got the policy and log snapshot, that helps. Two quick follow-ups from the reviewer: 
1) The committee would like explicit confirmation whether the KMS customer master keys are HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2/3 level) or software-based. If HSM-backed, do you have a vendor attestation or SSP excerpt we can include?
2) For the 2FA evidence, please include one example dated within the last 90 days that shows an admin-level login with 2FA challenge succeeded (redacted ids are fine) and the corresponding auth audit ID.

If you can confirm the HSM status and drop the admin 2FA example into the folder by EOD Mon, Jan 25, we'll be in good shape for the risk review next Wed.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Lucas
